description: Modal dialog for saving a new document version. Collects the version kind (minor or major), a label, and a description, requiring a description for major versions, and raises the result on confirm.

parameters.name: IsBusy
parameters.description: Whether create action is currently running.

parameters.name: OnCancel
parameters.description: Raised when the user confirms version creation.

parameters.name: OnCreate
parameters.description: Whether major versions require a non-empty description.

parameters.name: RequireMajorDescription
parameters.description: Whether create action is currently running.
